source.version: Part 10 — Canopy Architecture and Training Biology — Batch 02
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-26. Independent specialist approval remains pending and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-186–190 were reviewed for non-universal training claims. Public wording distinguishes direct cannabis evidence from broader plant-physiology mechanisms and avoids fixed timing, node-count, removal-percentage, or guaranteed-yield prescriptions.
source.note: THC-ENC-186–190 extend the controlled Training & Canopy Architecture topic. Variable outcomes, recovery, cultivar effects, density, light distribution, and source-sink tradeoffs must remain visible in public wording.
